svg.aria-label: Physical overview of one rev-1 pod. Panel A shows the left pod from outside with the lid off, which is KiCad top view of the 34 by 13 mm board: MCU, crystal, core SMPS, switch, test pads and wire pads on the lid-side face; mic, charger, bridge, LDO and dock protection on the cell-side face. The 175 mAh cell lies under the board, the magnetic dock target sits in the belly floor, the NiTi arm leaves the heel under the rear and carries four wires to the pad at the tragus. Panel B is a section through the mic showing the stack from the temple arm outward: adapter, tub wall, tape, cell, foam, board, lid and armour plate, with the mic port path. Ten numbered interfaces are listed on the right.
svg.text: Rev-1 pod: where every block lives, and what crosses between regions
One pod (both are identical; the shells are mirror images). Pod mm from hw/mech/shell_r1.py + frame.py; board draft hw/pod/place_r1.py; nets as in docs/system/integration-map.md. 2026-10-01.
A · Left pod from outside, lid off (= KiCad's top view of the board; front of the glasses on the left)
dock target YZT0675 (5 contacts face down)
U2 on B ports through a Ø0.6 board hole (pod x 33.73), crosses the 1.5 mm
open gap (no seal), leaves by the lid's Ø1.0 hole at pod x 34.5: 0.77 mm off.
Printed plunger Ø2.9 in the lid's Ø3.2 bore under a bonded silicone skin
presses SW1 (KMT022, travel 0.15 ± 0.1 mm) → BTN → PA0.
4 litz: OUT_A, OUT_B, LED_A, LED_K. Pad board → strut bore Ø1.2 → shrink
tube over the 3 mm flex zone → heel Ø1.0 → rear gap → J1 J2 J7 J8.
Ø0.80 superelastic wire in blind sockets (heel 4.0 deep, pad 3.5), held
by M1.4 set screws on filed flats. 20 mm, 30° sweep (O7b).
YZT0675 magnetic target glued and potted in the belly window (21.4 × 7.06);
5 wires → J3 J4 J10 J11 J12. Wire route not designed yet.
Renata 175 mAh, 0.25 mm VHB 4914 to the inner wall; leads → J5 VBAT,
J6 GND; optional cell NTC → J9 TS (then RT1 is not fitted).
Lid ribs press the 0.6 mm F clamp bands; foam strips push the B bands up,
but only 0.1 mm of each strip sits on the cell: no floor yet (open issue).
Lid locates on a 0.5 mm lip (none round the belly). Test: taped. Final:
bonded. Cut line: a 0.2 × 0.4 mm rebate on the tub only (below resin min).
Pod slides onto the separate frame adapter's dovetail and snaps; the
adapter clips the temple arm and adds 1.8 mm of stand-off.
Contact face (Sugru or silicone) on the skin in front of the tragus,
pressing inward (−y), ≥ 1 N (D1). LED ring on the pad's outer face (O8).
B · Section through the mic: head ← → outside
Holes drawn in line: the board
B-face block (cell side, seen through the board)
0.6 mm clamp band (no parts, both faces)
Where each logical block lives (integration-map.md §2, place_r1.py draft)
MCU, CORE_SMPS, CLOCK, SW1 (UI), R22/C22, TP1–6 (DEBUG), every J wire pad
MIC, BRIDGE, R21 (SELFTEST), CHARGER, LDO, VBAT_SENSE, dock protection (DOCK_USB), R14
cell (under the board) · dock target (belly) · exciter + LED board (pad) · 4 litz (arm)
Panel A is the LEFT pod: its outside view is exactly KiCad's top view (board x = 0 at the mic end, y = 0 at the top).
The RIGHT pod (the hw/mech CAD and its renders) is the mirror image: same board, F toward the lid, mic end forward;
its TP edge (board y 0) is at the bottom: seen from outside, KiCad's top view rotated 180° [derived]. Centre line: O16-5.
Scale 13 px/mm. Pod x rearward from the hinge, z up, y outward; board x = pod x − 30.6. Zones are approximate.
! Open: (A) heel wire exit (x 65.25–66.25) overlaps the rev-1 cell end (x 65.6); heel.py still checks the old cell.
(B) dock-wire route from the belly to J3/J4/J10–J12 not designed. (C) nothing seals the board-port-to-lid gap.
